A connected tracker mints the issue befo: mints the issue before any folder, then keys the folder to the issue key
An existing issue is adopted rather than: adopts an existing issue: no create call, folder + ref keyed to the given key
With no tracker connected, identity is m: routes provider:none to the local minter and constructs no tracker client
An unreachable tracker fails loudly and: creates no folder when the tracker mint fails
A rejected credential fails loudly and l: surfaces a tracker create failure and leaves no orphan
A missing credential fails loudly, never: fails loudly when a provider is configured but no credential resolves (AC2)
A successful issue-first create records: mints issue-first and records the ref in the tracker-map
updates a recorded ticket without creating
A known tracker key resolves to its loca: resolves a known tracker key to its ticket folder
Both GitHub and Linear key shapes resolv: resolves both GitHub and Linear key shapes to their own folders
An unknown tracker key returns the not-f: returns the not-found sentinel for an unknown key, without raising
A map entry pointing at a missing folder: returns null (not a dangling path) when the mapped folder is gone
